claims.assertion: Program synthesis and static analysis neural architectures (ipagnn, gfsa, aloe, bustle) represent control-flow graphs and syntax trees as message-passing topologies where execution transitions map to soft instruction-pointer attention weights or differentiable finite-state automata.

Differentiable quantum and biophysical packages (jax_dft, protenn, al_for_fep) embed learned neural functionals directly inside self-consistent field (SCF) Kohn-Sham loops (jax_dft/jax_dft/scf.py) and per-residue 3D CNN SavedModel exports (protenn saved_model.pb, 331,009 B).

AST documentation audits via DocSynchronizerService reveal a bimodal documentation distribution across research packages: reusable benchmark harnesses achieve 80.0% symbol docstring coverage (sign_language_detection, 17/17 public symbols), whereas mathematical inner loops exhibit 83.8% (jax_dft, 62/74 symbols) to 11.8% (aloe, 14/119 symbols).
